description: A page heading: a required title, an optional subtitle, and an optional actions slot.

title.description: The page title. Required: a page head with no title is a bug, not a state.

headingLevel.description: Which rung of the document outline the title takes. Only the element changes: the title's class is the same at every value, so the render is identical and no appearance follows from it. The member defaults to `h1` because a page head is the page's own title and the screen it heads carries no other. Under a hero, the one rung above it on the title ladder, the page head takes `h2` and leaves the page's single `h1` to the hero. That arrangement is the one where the default is wrong. The level is a member rather than something read off the page, because what a component renders is never derived from what sits above it. The value `none` is refused at runtime, as it is for every component whose `title` is required. This title is required, since it names the thing it draws. Such a title cannot also be told that its name is not one.

subtitle.description: A muted line under the title.

actions.description: Page-level controls, right-aligned in the head.
